usedFor: Magicbricks captures property leads, and Moco receives them as a lead through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in Magicbricks, then “Create Deal” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead becomes a Moco lead with its name, contact and company, ready for follow-up.

watchOut: Pair “New Leads” with “Create Deal”, not “Create Incoming Payment”, because a lead is not a payment yet.
